transcript:
Meeting header
Date: 2025-05-07
Time: 08:00 PT / 11:00 ET
Duration: ~50 minutes
Attendees: Aisha (Redwood AE), Tom (Redwood SE), Miguel (Content), Jenna (Design), Ben (Events Ops), Priya (Acme Growth), Mark (Acme Brand)

Auto-generated summary (editable):
- Align on promotional playbook for co-hosted webinar targeting platform engineers and developer teams.
- Confirm registrant target (1,000), primary channels (email, paid socials, partner outreach), and conversion KPI (5% day-of attendance).
- Assign owners for landing page, email cadence, creative, and speaker run-of-show.
- Key ask: Acme to approve logo and 60-sec customer clip; Redwood to deliver deck + demo video.

Topics:
- Goals & KPIs, Audience segments, Channels & budgets, Creative assets, Operational run-of-show, Legal/brand approvals, Rehearsal schedule

Action items (recorded above)

Transcript body:
[00:00:00] Aisha (AE): Hey everyone, thanks for joining. Quick roll call — shout your name and role so we have it on the record. Priya?
[00:00:12] Priya (Acme): Hi this is Priya Shah, Growth at Acme Cloud — we're running point for promotion on our side.
[00:00:16] Mark (Acme): Mark Rivera, Brand. I handle creative approvals and social.
[00:00:20] Tom (SE): Tom Reyes, Redwood SE, I'll cover the demo + technical talking points.
[00:00:24] Miguel (Content): Miguel Santos, content, I'll own the speaking outline and case study bullets.
[00:00:28] Jenna (Design): Jenna Park, design lead for event creative.
[00:00:30] Ben (Ops): Ben Lo, events ops, platform and rehearsal scheduling.
[00:00:34] Aisha: Cool. Main objectives — hit a 1k registrant goal, 5% live attendance, and capture 200 qualified leads for ACV 50k+ deals. Is that still aligned with Acme?
[00:00:42] Priya: Yes, that looks right; our tolerance for paid spend is limited so organic + partner push is preferred.
[00:00:00] Aisha: (laughs) noted, budgets tight. We'll prioritize email + partner co-marketing.
[00:00:58] Tom: From the demo side, we want to show Redwood Dedicated in a 8-10 minute demo — quick perf numbers, then a short Q&A. I need a clean customer metric we can put in the slide, like 2x latency improvement or 40% cost savings, does Acme have that?
[00:01:20] Priya: We have rough numbers; I'll pull a 90-day baseline and share. Might be approximate — legal may want a caveat.
[00:01:28] Mark: For brand, we need final logo files and any photo or short clip of the customer for the opener. We prefer 16:9 1080p for the short video.
[00:01:40] Miguel: I'll draft the talking points: problem statement, architecture, cost/latency outcomes, and a quick live demo flow. We'll aim 15 minutes of content + 10 minutes demo + 10 minutes Q&A to hit a 35-min run-of-show.
[00:01:55] Jenna: Design — hero banner + three social cards, plus an email header. I'll post examples after this call.
[00:02:04] Ben: Rehearsals — recommend two dry-runs: a content run and a tech run. We should book 45-minute slots. Ideally one the week of May 19 and one 3 days before the event.
[00:02:18] Aisha: Event platform — what do we prefer? Zoom webinar or StreamY? We talked before about streaming to LinkedIn. Thoughts?
[00:02:26] Priya: Acme can stream to LinkedIn if needed. For registration funnel we use HubSpot.
[00:02:30] Tom: Heads up — HubSpot integration requires a specific redirect URI; Ben can help. Also, we should add UTMs for tracking source.
[00:02:38] Ben: I'll coordinate the HubSpot form and UTMs. Also confirm whether GDPR opt-ins are required — Mark?
[00:02:44] Mark: Yes, for our EU lists we need explicit consent. We'll segment emails accordingly.
[00:02:50] Aisha: Good call. On promotion channels, here's a proposed split: Redwood-email 30%, Acme-email 25%, Paid socials 20% (LinkedIn ads), Organic socials 15%, Partners/podcasts 10%. Given limited paid budget, we can reallocate more to emails.
[00:03:10] Priya: Can we run an A/B on subject lines? We typically see a 10% lift with personalization.
[00:03:15] Miguel: Yes — propose two subject lines and two CTAs. I'll prepare copy variations.
[00:03:20] Jenna: For creative QA, we need final copy by May 12 to deliver designs on May 13.
[00:03:26] Aisha: Ok, deadlines noted. Now the landing page: Miguel, can you draft the hero headline and three bullets? We need a clear lead capture and a one-click add to calendar.
[00:03:36] Miguel: Draft will include a short customer quote, three bullets on what attendees will learn, and speaker bios. Also include a short form field for company size to qualify leads.
[00:03:48] Priya: On our end we'll add co-host logo and push to our customers list; we'll also run a small sponsored post to a targeted list if budget allows.
[00:03:56] Tom: Demo checklist — short script, pre-baked prompts, and a demo recording in case live amp goes weird. I can pre-record a 2-min clip of the model response as backup.
[00:04:10] Priya: That helps. Legal/brand approvals — who owns sign-off for the deck? Mark?
[00:04:15] Mark: Yes, brand approves creative; legal will review any claims. We'll need to run the 60-sec customer clip by legal as well.
[00:04:24] Aisha: I'll send the deck to legal and cc you, Mark. Also include a short disclaimer on performance metrics.
[00:04:32] Ben: Ops question — what's the rehearsal availability window for presenters? Week of May 19 seems tight for some folks.
[00:04:38] Priya: We can do May 20 at 16:00 PT for the main rehearsal.
[00:04:44] Jenna: Design needs a logo lockup from Acme — vector preferred. Priya, can you drop that in the shared drive?
[00:04:50] Priya: Yes I'll upload an .ai and .svg.
[00:04:54] Tom: Quick note about talking points: avoid deep internals like KV cache sizing or raw kernel optimizations — those confuse a non-engineering audience. Focus on outcomes and architecture at a high level. We'll have a technical appendix if needed.
[00:05:10] Miguel: Good plan. We'll include an appendix link in the follow-up email.
[00:05:16] Aisha: On measurement — primary KPI is registrants and MQLs. Also track engagement (questions asked, poll responses). We'll run one poll mid-webinar.
[00:05:27] Priya: Poll idea: "Which is your top constraint? Cost / Latency / Reliability / Security". That helps segmentation.
[00:05:34] Mark: For social, short quote cards and a 15-sec teaser video perform best. Can Redwood cut a 15-sec clip from Tom's pre-record?
[00:05:42] Tom: Yes, I can give a 60-sec clip and Redwood can slice it.
[00:05:46] Aisha: On partners — do we invite any channel partners or ISVs to co-promote? This can help the reach.
[00:05:52] Priya: We have a couple of partners, but they need 3 weeks notice for co-marketing.
[00:05:57] Miguel: If partner pushes are possible, adjust timeline for earlier approvals.
[00:06:03] Ben: Platform backup plan — if Zoom webinar fails we can pivot to stream on YouTube and send a redirect link. Need to ensure registration links map correctly.
[00:06:12] Aisha: Good contingency. Legal items — any PII concerns with HubSpot integration or recordings?
[00:06:18] Priya: We store registrant data in HubSpot under our account; Redwood only gets anonymized attendance reports unless we explicitly share. We'll confirm.
[00:06:26] Tom: We should avoid sending any raw logs or model inputs from the demo — stick to sanitized examples.
[00:06:33] Aisha: Noted. Next — sponsor slots. Acme asked whether we can offer a sponsored segment; budget is small. Thoughts?
[00:06:41] Miguel: We can offer a 2-minute sponsor mention in exchange for a small co-ad budget. Keep it brief.
[00:06:48] Mark: Brand wants no hard sells in the main presentation; sponsor mention fine at the top.
[00:06:54] Aisha: We'll keep it light. Now timing and calendar invites — event date proposed: June 4, 2025 at 10:00 AM PT. Is that ok?
[00:07:03] Priya: June 4 works.
[00:07:05] Ben: I'll reserve the webinar slot and set up calendar invites, including the dry-run times.
[00:07:10] Miguel: Promotion timeline — week-by-week: Week 0 (now) announce to internal lists and partners; Week 1 email blast; Week 2 paid push and social organic ramp; Week of event — reminder emails 7 days, 2 days, 1 day, and 1 hour.
[00:07:25] Aisha: We should do a targeted re-engage send to past webinar attendees. I'll pull a small list.
[00:07:30] Priya: On tracking, add a hidden field for customer segment so we can route top accounts to SDR follow-up.
[00:07:36] Tom: For the demo, include a slide with pre and post metrics — if Acme approves the numbers I'll add them.
[00:07:42] Priya: I'll try to get a signed note from our analytics team by May 14.
[00:07:48] Mark: One more on branding — can Redwood provide a co-branded email template with their logo on the left? We prefer it for consistency.
[00:07:54] Aisha: Yes, we'll share the HubSpot-ready template.
[00:07:58] Miguel: Q&A moderation — propose collecting questions via Slido and letting Tom pick top ones. Also have a rep triage chat questions.
[00:08:08] Ben: I'll set up Slido and the chat moderation roster.
[00:08:12] Priya: Do we have a plan for recording distribution? We'll want an on-demand landing page and follow-up nurture sequence.
[00:08:18] Aisha: Redwood will share recording and shortened clip within 48 hours, and a nurture email sequence for registrants.
[00:08:24] Miguel: We'll create a 3-email nurture: thank you + recording, a technical deep-dive content piece, and customer case study.
[00:08:33] Mark: Legal: we need a clause in the follow-up that states recorded content is co-owned and can be used by both parties.
[00:08:39] Aisha: I'll put that in an email and ask legal to sign off quickly.
[00:08:44] Priya: Ok that's fine.
[00:08:46] Aisha: Alright — recap of owners and due dates: Miguel to deliver talking points by May 10; Aisha to share promo cadence + template May 12; Jenna designs due May 13; Priya to upload logos and confirm clip by May 14; Ben to book platform by May 9; Dry-run on May 20 16:00 PT. Any objections?
[00:09:05] Mark: No objections.
[00:09:07] Priya: All good.
[00:09:09] Tom: One small ask — can we include a short customer Q&A slot? Maybe collect two pre-submitted questions from Acme's customers.
[00:09:16] Priya: Yes we can surface those.
[00:09:20] Aisha: Perfect. Last thing — do we want a follow-up internal playbook for SDRs to convert registrants? I can draft a simple one-pager.
[00:09:27] Miguel: Yes please. That will help conversion.
[00:09:30] Aisha: Great. Thanks everyone — I'll send notes and the initial deck by EOD tomorrow.
[00:09:35] Priya: Thanks all.
[00:09:37] Mark: Thanks.

(End of recording)

Notes about transcription: some product names were slightly misheard by the auto-transcription (e.g., "Redwood Dedicated" came through as "Redwood Dedicayted" in places) and some technical terms like "KV cache" and "HSM" were imperfectly transcribed. Speaker attribution was accurate after roll-call but occasional speaker overlap occurred.
